_comment: Measured outcomes against PROTOCOL.md. Nothing here redefines the design; it only records what was observed. Off-ledger exploration goes in FINDINGS.md, never here. RESET 2026-09-06 for the A12 rebuild: every number below M1 was discarded with the artifacts that produced them (A12, FINDINGS F5) and is being re-measured on the corrected harness. The superseded values remain in git history at febefa9.

M1.note: Town01 (A3). Lit/unlit resolved (A4): site 1 unlit at 4.5, site 3 lit at 25.7 mean brightness, night lamps off

M2.note: REBUILT on the corrected harness. a_max 0.505 g (was 0.868 g -- an integration artifact, FINDINGS F5), t_lat 0.150 s over 10 reps/speed, r_req 52.0 ft at 25 mph; contact detector validated on a deliberate crash; lead oracle 10/10 perfect and 0/10 late; pedestrian oracle 10/10 and 0/10

M3.note: REBUILT. Expert 10/10 at both regulatory endpoints, 14.0 ft standoff at each; capture check places a frame to 0.000 m and 0.010 of image range; scenario objects rebuilt and both oracle checks pass

M4.note: REBUILT with three arms and all THREE FMVSS lighting conditions. Every cell 10/10 on PROTOCOL section 7's frozen pass. P_pts3 brakes at 287.57 ft in daylight on the ped scenario, 10/10 premature and 0 contacts -- a property A defect that section 7's criterion does not fail and that is recorded beside the verdict, never inside it

M5.note: REBUILT. All eight behavioural gates pass over the COVERED axis: capture 0.108-0.544, in-between 0.156-0.678. The in-between gate first failed for P_pts/ped at [+12.542, +7.715] deg (1.016); PROTOCOL section 4's repair split it at +10.128 and the halves read 0.268 and 0.368 (FINDINGS F7)

M6.note: REBUILT. Property S over the covered axis: P_pts 4/16 and 4/16, P_cont 16/16 and 15/16, P_pts3 6/16 and 3/16. Zero undecided across all six. The third regulatory lighting condition NARROWS the falsified band (50.3 -> 43.0 deg on lead) and does not close it. Committed before any driving

M7.note: REBUILT, twelve drives: six at sub-interval midpoints and six at the certificate's EXHIBITED witness illumination. Agreement on PROTOCOL section 7's frozen criterion: cell 4 (P_cont/lead) 17/17, cell 3 (P_cont/ped) 15/17, cell 2 (P_pts/lead) 5/17, cell 1 (P_pts/ped) 4/17. ZERO certified-then-failed anywhere -- no soundness violation in any cell. Cells 1 and 3 contradict their pre-registration and need dispositions per section 8

M8.note: A12 rebuild: figure and report to be regenerated from the rebuilt results

1.note: FALSIFIED over 48.271 deg; every falsified sub-interval nonetheless drove clean, so every disagreement is conservative | endpoints darkness_highbeam 10/10, darkness_lowbeam 10/10, daylight 10/10
1.width_note: total width of the falsified sub-intervals over the covered axis, degrees of sun altitude (axis 60 to -30); 1 uncovered sub-interval(s) excluded

2.note: FALSIFIED over 50.320 deg; 1 of 12 falsified sub-intervals failed when driven | endpoints darkness_highbeam 10/10, darkness_lowbeam 10/10, daylight 10/10
2.width_note: total width of the falsified sub-intervals over the covered axis, degrees of sun altitude (axis 60 to -30); 1 uncovered sub-interval(s) excluded

3.note: FALSIFIED over 0.753 deg; every falsified sub-interval nonetheless drove clean, so every disagreement is conservative | endpoints darkness_highbeam 10/10, darkness_lowbeam 10/10, daylight 10/10
3.width_note: total width of the falsified sub-intervals over the covered axis, degrees of sun altitude (axis 60 to -30); 1 uncovered sub-interval(s) excluded

4.note: CERTIFIED in all 16 covered sub-intervals; drove clean in all 16 driven | endpoints darkness_highbeam 10/10, darkness_lowbeam 10/10, daylight 10/10

5.note: NO HARNESS. The FMVSS 127 false-activation scenario is specified in PROTOCOL sections 2 and 9 and has never been built: scenarios.py tiles the trench plate to the standard's dimensions and nothing drives it. See docs/STATE_OF_PLAY.md for what it needs. Property A is currently verified on the no-target control, which is a legitimate must-not-brake property and is NOT the standard's false-activation scenario.

capture_check.note: BEHAVIOURAL, worst of the four policy-scenario pairs: policy output on a placed frame against the same policy driving through that spot. 0.108 / 0.112 / 0.331 / 0.544

in_between_check.note: BEHAVIOURAL, worst over COVERED sub-intervals of the four pairs: 0.156 / 0.222 / 0.506 / 0.678. A sub-interval the knot measurement declares uncovered is excluded from the coverage claim and so cannot fail a gate about that claim

primitives._note: a_max is read from the stop TIME, as PROTOCOL section 3 defines it; a_max_g_from_distance reads the same stops from the distance covered and is the consistency check that condemned the pre-A12 value (FINDINGS F5).
